name: Romp Dog Club
tagline: Grooming, daycare and overnight boarding for dogs on the east side. Clean dogs, tired dogs, happy dogs.
hours_note: Grooming by appointment · daycare drop-off until 10am
hero_facts: Groups sorted by size and play style

service_groups.name: Grooming
service_groups.body: Baths, haircuts and nail trims, one dog at a time.

service_groups.name: Daycare
service_groups.body: A full day of supervised play, a nap, and a ride home tired.

service_groups.name: Boarding
service_groups.body: Overnights in a quiet suite, with daycare included.

service_groups.name: Walks & training
service_groups.body: Neighborhood walks and one-on-one manners sessions.

day.title: Drop-off
day.body: A quick sniff at the gate, then straight to the group that fits their size and energy.

day.title: Yard time
day.body: Fetch, chase and wrestling on turf and gravel, always with a handler in the yard.

day.title: Lunch and a nap
day.body: Their own food, then two hours of lights-down rest in the quiet room.

day.title: Afternoon play
day.body: Smaller groups, puzzle toys, and a rinse for anyone who found the mud.

day.title: The report card
day.body: Who they played with, how they ate, and anything worth knowing. Written, not guessed.

rules.title: Up-to-date vaccines
rules.body: Rabies, DHPP and bordetella, with records from your vet before the first visit.

rules.title: A free meet-and-greet
rules.body: A half-day trial so we can learn their play style and they can learn the yard.

rules.title: Spayed or neutered after seven months
rules.body: For group play only. Grooming and walks welcome every dog.

rules.title: Flea and tick prevention
rules.body: Whatever your vet recommends, kept current year-round.

art_direction.identity: The neighborhood dog park's signage: brown enamel park-department sign plates with a cream keyline and rivets, a gravel-grey canvas, and one tennis-ball chartreuse. Warm and outdoorsy, never cutesy — no paw prints, no cartoons.
art_direction.type: Overpass (weight 800, tight tracking) for every heading — the highway-gothic lettering on park signs. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for body and UI. Headlines are big and blunt; body stays at a comfortable reading size.
art_direction.color: One accent: chartreuse (bg-primary) for the booking button, the headline swash, prices on the brown signs, and the closing call-to-action band. Enamel brown (bg-secondary) carries the sign plates and the footer. Everything else is gravel canvas, stone surface, cream cards, ink and muted text. Never add another color.
art_direction.signature: The trailhead directory — a big brown enamel sign listing every service like a park wayfinding post: pictogram, name, one line, a chartreuse price, and an arrow. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Plain, warm and a little dry. Short sentences, real numbers and real routines. No exclamation marks, no 'fur babies', no pet puns.
